A pretty damn good game. Not great, but well worth at least $10 just for the solo campaign alone. Multiplayer is probably well dead, so unless you can team up with other players, don't even think about it.
Edit: With the 10th Anniversary re-release, the multiplayer lives again. Well worth the asking price.

Wonderful and fairly immersive WH40k FPS game. The melee is a little clunky, but honestly playing an assault marine and tearing my way through the enemies of the Imperium with a power axe is my favourite part. Get a DLC skin if you REALLY like one chapter, they look much nicer than most of the generic stuff you can create, but they don't affect anything and you can still earn and customise some really awesome armor just playing the game. Bring in some friends for extra fun, I've spent hours screwing around with my friends in private multiplayer games. Wait for a sale, you can get this game for like $12 CAD every few months.

WH40K: Space Marine deserved to sell a lot better than it did. Granted, I had my doubts that Relic, a developer that had only made RTS games, could pull off an action game. However, much like Creative Assembly, Relic's foray into a different genre turned out to be a surprising success. At first glance, Space Marine looks a lot like Gears of War but it plays much differently. GoW is largely about hugging cover while Space Marine highly encourages you to wade into battle. Hacking apart hordes of Orkz with your chainsword never gets old. The combat isn't especially deep or challenging but it is satisfying and the game has good pacing, resulting in a short but sweet experience.

Of all the action-oriented WH40K games, Space Marine is easily the best and well worth your time if you enjoy run and gun/hack and slash action games.

fun game for 40k fans looking for something other than an rts. some pretty cool mods with pretty simple install. really good combat and great gore glory kills. guns feel and sound like they should especially heavy bolter. pretty cheap and id say has good replay value.story is ok not great but not bad either
